page_title: KOL 4-1 HAM | FC Koln v Hamburger SV 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van den Berg R. Shoulder Injury

commentary.text: 90+13' The match has just finished.
90+12' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
90+10' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Daniel Heuer Fernandes, who makes a comfortable save.
90+9' 4 - 1 Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb into the top right corner. What a perfect shot.
90+7' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

90+6' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.

90+4' 3 - 1 Goal! Jakub Kaminski shows great vision to find Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 3:1.
90+4' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+3' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
90' There will be a minimum of 12 min. of added time.
90' Merlin Polzin prepares a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga is replaced by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger).
90' The substitution has been made. Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) has replaced Jean-Luc Dompe.
88' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from FC Koln.
84' Referee Daniel Schlager halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Merlin Polzin, then shows him a yellow.
83' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is awarded a yellow card and sent off by Daniel Schlager because it's his second one today.
83' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
79' Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) is penalised.
79' An infringement by Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger) results in a yellow card and as it's the second time today, he also sees a red and is dismissed by Daniel Schlager.
78' Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger) is booked by the referee.
78' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Philippe trots off the pitch and is replaced by Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger).
77' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) replacing William Mikelbrencis.
76' Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
74' Booking. Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) receives a caution from the referee.
73' Substitution. Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) on for Ragnar Ache.
72' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) has a goal ruled out for offside!
72' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

71' Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Hamburger SV win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
70' Great teamplay by Hamburger SV as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
68' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for an infringement.
67' Today's match ends for Isak Johannesson who will be replaced by Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln).
67' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Linton Maina will be replaced by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).
67' It's time for a substitution. Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) comes on in place of Florian Kainz.
66' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
65' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
64' Hamburger SV enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
62' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
61' 2 - 1 Goal! Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 2:1.
61' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ransford Konigsdorffer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger).
58' Marvin Schwabe makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) after a cross from the side.
57' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
56' The Hamburger SV players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
52' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Hamburger SV goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.

50' Goal! Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Marvin Schwabe is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:1.
48' 2 - 0 Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
48' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle after Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to FC Koln in a dangerous position.
46' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) serves up a nice cross, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes punches the ball away.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Lukas Kwasniok probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln). He is replaced by Sebastian Sebulonsen.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) brings an opponent down and Daniel Schlager interrupts the game.
45+1' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The linesman makes the right call and Hamburger SV will have a corner.

45' This shall not pass! Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Hamburger SV force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
44' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
42' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
40' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
40' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

38' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
38' FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
35' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a save.
34' Hamburger SV fail to score from a corner as Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln) leaps to collect the ball.
33' The ball is laid off to Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the right side of the goal and forces Marvin Schwabe to make a decent save.
31' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
30' FC Koln force a corner. They send men into the box.
29' Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) plays a terrific long ball forward to Ransford Konigsdorffer, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
27' Hamburger SV control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
24' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Miro Muheim (Hamburger). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
22' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
21' 54:46 – the ratio of ball possession.
17' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) picks up an injury.
16' The free kick is delivered by Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

15' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Schlager stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. That's a free kick to FC Koln.
15' An attempted cross from Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
13' The game is interrupted now, Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

12' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Daniel Heuer Fernandes.
11' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
10' Daniel Schlager shows a yellow card to Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) for his blatant foul.
9' FC Koln seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
7' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the left post.
5' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
3' Neat passing move from Hamburger SV in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' FC Koln seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
